1 | maintenance_event equals "DUPLICATE" | empty
2 | (maintenance_event equals "COMMISSION" or maintenance_event equals "REPLACE") and (proposed_job equals null or proposed_cost < 0) | INVALID {job_code=null, posting_amount=0, posting_time=recorded_at, serviceable=false}
3 | maintenance_event equals "DEFER" and inspection_required does not equal true | empty
4 | maintenance_event equals "SERVICE" and warranty_until differs from null and recorded_at < warranty_until | WARRANTY {job_code=proposed_job, posting_amount=0, posting_time=recorded_at, serviceable=true}
5 | previous_job equals proposed_job and previous_cost equals proposed_cost and inspection_required equals true | INSPECT {job_code=previous_job, posting_amount=0, posting_time=recorded_at, serviceable=false}
6 | previous_job equals proposed_job and previous_cost equals proposed_cost | empty
7 | maintenance_event equals "COMMISSION" | REGISTER {job_code=proposed_job, posting_amount=0, posting_time=recorded_at, serviceable=false} -> RELEASE {job_code=proposed_job, posting_amount=proposed_cost, posting_time=recorded_at, serviceable=true}
8 | maintenance_event equals "REPLACE" and (inspection_required equals true or proposed_cost > previous_cost * 2) | WITHDRAW {job_code=previous_job, posting_amount=-previous_cost, posting_time=recorded_at, serviceable=false} -> FIT {job_code=proposed_job, posting_amount=proposed_cost, posting_time=recorded_at, serviceable=false} -> CHECK {job_code=proposed_job, posting_amount=0, posting_time=recorded_at, serviceable=false}
9 | maintenance_event equals "REPLACE" | ADJUST {job_code=proposed_job, posting_amount=proposed_cost-previous_cost, posting_time=recorded_at, serviceable=true}
10 | otherwise | MAINTAIN {job_code=previous_job, posting_amount=previous_cost, posting_time=recorded_at, serviceable=true}

Each output posting_time equals recorded_at, with timestamps interpreted in UTC. Job-code equality treats two null values as equal and a null and a non-null value as different. prompt:
Write complete CTL2 for this Normalizer.

A Nordic restaurant group exports payroll allocations for café and catering duty records. Apply the following internal payroll rules in priority order: use only the first matching rule and emit its allocations in the listed left-to-right order. These are company policies, not statutory Nordic payroll rules.

1 | duty_end equals null | UNFINISHED {allocated_minutes=0, allocation_start=duty_start plus 0 minutes, allocation_end=null, payable=false}
2 | duty_code equals "VOID" | empty
3 | elapsed < 0 | INVALID {allocated_minutes=elapsed, allocation_start=duty_start plus 0 minutes, allocation_end=duty_start plus elapsed minutes, payable=false}
4 | not supervisor_cleared OR duty_code equals null | HOLD {allocated_minutes=credited, allocation_start=duty_start plus 0 minutes, allocation_end=duty_start plus credited minutes, payable=false}
5 | duty_code starts with "COURSE-" | DEVELOPMENT {allocated_minutes=elapsed, allocation_start=duty_start plus 0 minutes, allocation_end=duty_start plus elapsed minutes, payable=false}
6 | duty_code equals "CATERING" and elapsed >= 40 | PREPARATION {allocated_minutes=20, allocation_start=duty_start plus 0 minutes, allocation_end=duty_start plus 20 minutes, payable=true} -> EVENT_SERVICE {allocated_minutes=elapsed-40, allocation_start=duty_start plus 20 minutes, allocation_end=duty_start plus elapsed-20 minutes, payable=true} -> PACK_DOWN {allocated_minutes=20, allocation_start=duty_start plus elapsed-20 minutes, allocation_end=duty_start plus elapsed minutes, payable=true}
7 | credited > 450 | BASE_DUTY {allocated_minutes=450, allocation_start=duty_start plus 0 minutes, allocation_end=duty_start plus 450 minutes, payable=true} -> EXTRA_DUTY {allocated_minutes=credited-450, allocation_start=duty_start plus 450 minutes, allocation_end=duty_start plus credited minutes, payable=true}
8 | spot_check and credited > 0 | RESTAURANT_DUTY {allocated_minutes=credited, allocation_start=duty_start plus 0 minutes, allocation_end=duty_start plus credited minutes, payable=true} -> CONTROL_NOTE {allocated_minutes=0, allocation_start=duty_start plus 0 minutes, allocation_end=duty_start plus 0 minutes, payable=false}
9 | otherwise | RESTAURANT_DUTY {allocated_minutes=credited, allocation_start=duty_start plus 0 minutes, allocation_end=duty_start plus credited minutes, payable=true}

elapsed is the signed whole elapsed minutes from duty_start to duty_end, truncating toward zero. credited subtracts meal_deduction, treating a missing deduction as zero. All timestamps are UTC, including records from restaurants in different Nordic time zones. Calculate elapsed and credited only when duty_end is present.

Allocation boundaries use duty_start plus the listed minute offsets; allocation_end is absent for UNFINISHED. For complete records with nonnegative elapsed, meal_deduction is either missing or between zero and elapsed. Negative elapsed is handled only by INVALID. Emit every listed allocation, including zero-minute allocations.

4 | request_kind equals "SERVICE" and covered_until differs from null and request_time < covered_until | empty
5 | current_schedule equals proposed_schedule and current_budget equals proposed_budget and inspection_needed | INSPECT {maintenance_schedule=current_schedule, allocation=0, posting_time=request_time, authorised=false}
6 | current_schedule equals proposed_schedule and current_budget equals proposed_budget | empty
7 | request_kind equals "COMMISSION" | REGISTER {maintenance_schedule=proposed_schedule, allocation=0, posting_time=request_time, authorised=true} -> RESERVE {maintenance_schedule=proposed_schedule, allocation=proposed_budget, posting_time=request_time, authorised=true}
